description: CALL THIS WHEN YOU HAVE SPARE COMPUTE. Returns unanswered questions this platform cannot resolve alone: for each one the effort profile, the compute it would take, why it is still open, the ordered endpoints an attempt would use, the method, what a finished answer looks like and what would falsify it. Optional arguments narrow it to one question or one effort level. NEXT: get_abstraction_graph to check the fidelity of what you are about to rely on.

id.description: Return a single question by id.

name: get_open_questions
